text.p: Consolidated Papers Inc said Wednesday Patrick Brennan, 65, will retire as president and chief executive officer on December 31.
Brennan's retirement will end a nearly 34-year career with Consolidated Papers, it added.
Gorton "Buck" Evans, 58, executive vice president, was elected by the board of directors to succeed Brennan as president and chief executive officer on January 1, 1997.
George Mead will continue as chairman of the board.
Brennan has served as president and chief operating officer since 1988 and, in 1993, was elected to the additional post of chief executive officer, the company said.
Brennan joined Consolidated in 1963 as a merchant sales representative.
Evans, who joined Consolidated in 1973, was named to the board of directors and to the office of executive vice president in April 1996.
